title: Retry and reconcile
current: Reconcile accepts only outcome_unknown and failed launches, so the steering report shows its bind recipe only in those states; any other state says no command binds it and to relaunch once the native exits and the cause is fixed. A launch reconcile already settled as never created shows only relaunch. A retry keeps the launch id but carries a new attestation, and the worker's replay marker names that attestation, so an earlier delivered attempt never blocks the retry from registering.
